assumptions.statement: Official detailed planning controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire safety and engineering constraints are not in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, alignment, demolition, investment and construction statements remain conceptual and cannot support approval.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios describe this intake model only; all dependent layers and metrics must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual building footprints represent spatial prototypes rather than surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/infill labels are methods for later survey, not parcel-level decisions.

assumptions.statement: Mobility lines express desired connections, not engineering centerlines or road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Transport, accessibility, bridge, junction and station works require official data, surveys and specialist design.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection scopes and construction-control zones are not included.
assumptions.impact: Cultural nodes use low-disturbance, reversible concepts and require heritage review before siting.

assumptions.statement: Utility, drainage, flood, energy and fire-capacity data are absent.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute and public-space services are service concepts only, without capacity or routing claims.

assumptions.statement: Scenario evaluation uses public, consented or aggregated data and always retains a non-digital path and human appeal.
assumptions.impact: No face recognition, persistent identity tracking or automated eligibility decision is part of this proposal.

assumptions.statement: Named events, stewardship roles and phasing are governance prototypes.
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute confirmed organizer, government, funding or procurement commitments.

assumptions.statement: International cases are mechanism references, not direct spatial benchmarks.
assumptions.impact: Their governance and spatial devices require localization, legal review and public participation.
